rules: Quote exactly; never paraphrase inside quotation marks.
A card praises the work, never Tinct or its edition.
No photos or likenesses of the people quoted.
Only cards with recheck == 'verified' may be sent to readers.

why_read_old_books.quote: Any book that survived for two thousand years has been filtered through many people.
But I really think people should be much more biased towards older books than they are.
You could spend your entire life only reading timeless works which is what smart people used to do.
We all, therefore, need the books that will correct the characteristic mistakes of our own period.
why_read_old_books.context: Introduction to Athanasius, On the Incarnation

why_read_old_books.quote: For what are the classics but the noblest recorded thoughts of man?
